**CSE455 staff meeting — next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov)**

Hello all — I'd like us to meet for an hour next week to go over the course. Could each of you send me your availability for those days, 09:00–17:00, ideally by tomorrow morning (Thu)? Once I have everyone's windows I'll fix a slot and book a room.

Thank you — Prof. Alvarez

Hello — Prof. Alvarez, CSE455.

I'd like to set up a one-hour staff meeting with my TAs during the week of Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, 09:00–17:00. Two questions:

1. Could you send me the official schedule for that week (lectures, seminars, university meetings) so I don't clash with anything I don't have on my own calendar?
2. Is a room free for a meeting of eight people on one of those days? I'll confirm the day and hour as soon as my TAs have sent their availability.

Thank you.

Hi all — Omar here. My next week is unfortunately fully booked Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; the only open gaps are 30 minutes: Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30. No free hour, I'm afraid.

If the staff meeting has to be a full hour, the block I could shift is one of my Focus sessions (Mon 13:00–13:50, Thu 12:50–13:50 or 15:50–17:00, Fri 12:20–13:30) — tell me which slot works for the group and I'll move it.

I've checked my calendar (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) and I don't have a free hour inside 09:00–17:00 on any of those days — my teaching, office hours, grading and research blocks run almost back to back.

The only gaps I have all week are half hours:
- Mon: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Tue: 15:00–15:30

If you let me know a slot you and the others settle on, I'll see whether I can move one of my own blocks (e.g. focus or grading time is more flexible than office hours or sections) and confirm. Alternatively, I'm happy to send written notes if I have to miss it.

- **Tue 24:** 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
